answer: 9/11 memorial ceremony: Laredo Port of Entry, at the Juarez-Lincoln Bridge, 09/11/2026, honoring the victims, survivors, first responders and all those affected by the terrorist attacks of Sept. Operation Tidal Wave search returns 2 releases; the Sept 25, 2026 release reports 87 cruise ship crew members removed at the Port of Boston. The other Boston release: 'CBP officers remove another 10 cruise ship crewmembers in Boston following Operation Tidal Wave investigation'.
